notes.title: V1.9 Update - Tell You Some Secrets
notes.content:
New Content:
1. Added game tutorials, including key tutorials, mechanic tutorials, weapon stats and enemy stats.
2. Adjusted the amount of experience required to level up, and the amount of experience required for players to level up after level 40 has been changed to a fixed and no longer increases.
3. The working hours of the hound are adjusted to 8:00~18:00 (previously 9:00~17:00). Eight, some players are unhappy with your 9-to-5 work, work overtime for me!
4. Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: V1.8 Update - More Prey
notes.content:
New Content:
1. Added three new prey: weasel, boar and anaconda.
2. The base stamina cost of the bare hand has been adjusted to 8 (previously 9).
3. Adjusted the price of cargos purchased by black market owners.
4. Now you will have 1500 ¥ at home at the start of the game (previously 0 ¥).

notes.title: V1.7 Update - Steam Achievements
notes.content:
New Content:
1. Added Steam achievements, a total of 11 achievements.
2. Added the novice guide dialogue of the starting father to guide novice players to start the game better. Stamina recovery per turn in the game = (current_stamina/stamina_max) * recovery.
3. In battle, an information item has been added to the information bar on the right side to indicate how much stamina the target will recover at the end of the round.

notes.title: V1.6 Update——Why not give up
notes.content:
New Content:
Added the option to give up the battle when player fights. If the "Give up" is performed, the player dies and returns to the game title. Seeing that the decline is fully evident and the defeat is decided, the long pain is better than the short pain, and it is better to end it directly than to endure the torture.

I apologize to players who endured torture in previous versions of the game.
We welcome more suggestions for improvement and optimization. We accept all suggestions with an open mind.
